title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E4 — The World of Succulents
Martha explores how to care for succulents including watering, fertilizing, and repotting.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E5 — Inside Martha's Vegetable Greenhouse; Seed Starting
Martha takes us inside her vegetable greenhouse to see how she has turned her harvest into a year-round bounty; she collects, stores, and sows seeds, and makes her perfect green drink.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E6 — The Incredible World of Orchids
Martha visits the incredible Orchid Show at the New York Botanical Garden; this year's show immerses you in a mesmerizing array of orchids designed by acclaimed artist Lily Kwong.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E7 — Hens and Chicks
Now with over 200 chickens and 20 different breeds, Martha shares her vast knowledge about raising and caring for her flock; learn the how-tos of building a coop.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S3 E6 — Pies
Peach crumble pie; key lime pie baked in a Graham cracker crust; coconut cream pie.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S3 E8 — Cupcakes
Four cupcake recipes: blueberry swirl, lemon meringue, red velvet with cream cheese frosting, and one-bite double Diablo.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S3 E13 — Muffins
Giant bran muffins filled with raisins; citrusy mini orange muffins; healthy morning muffins; plum-filled coffee cake muffins; glazed zucchini muffins.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S4 E1 — Citrus
Orange chiffon cake; Shaker lemon pie; lime squares with pistachio Graham cracker crust; upside-down cake made with three kinds of citrus.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S4 E2 — Northeast
Cranberry tart with currant jelly and cognac; mini chocolate whoopie pies; New York crumb cake; babka.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S4 E3 — Pumpkin
Pumpkin pecan pie; cheesecake swirled with pumpkin; pumpkin bread; deep dish pumpkin pie.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S4 E4 — Nuts
Traditional linzertorte; oatmeal cookies with a peanut butter filling; walnut cake; pecan tart.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E4 — Vegetables
Blanching, steaming and roasting vegetables.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E5 — Pasta
Making fresh pasta by hand and with a machine; shaping dough into farfalle and tortelli.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E6 — Pasta Sauces
Traditional pasta sauce; slow-cooked Bolognese; puttanesca; carbonara; a light sauce made with bottarga.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E7 — Fishmonger
Seafood chef Dave Pasternack explains buying, butchering and storing fish; boning a round or flat fish; cleaning a squid; crudo.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E8 — Sauteing
Dredging meat or fish in flour, then cooking over high heat to ensure a golden-brown finish; wiener schnitzel; chicken piccata; sole a la meunière; pan sauces.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E9 — Dumplings
Italian dumplings gnocchi and gnudi; Polish pierogi.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E10 — Grains
An overview of popular grains including quinoa and bulgur wheat and how to cook them.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E3 — Baking Baguettes and Breads
Martha tours Breads Bakery with owner Gadi Paleg and learns about their award-winning baked goods; Martha and bakers make Breads Bakery's baguette, challah, and egg sandwich.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E4 — Chef David Burke's Modern Classics
Chef David Burke brings his modern classic dishes to Martha's kitchen; a bacon clothesline, calamari noodles, miso chicken with ginger and vegetables, and key lime pie are on the menu.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E5 — All Things Yogurt
Homa Dashtaki, owner of the White Moustache yogurt company, shares her technique for making yogurt, Persian rice with a yogurt dip, and whey pancakes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E2 — Japanese Knife Skills
Martha takes a deep dive into how to choose and maintain the best knives; Chef Masa Takayama shares his superior knife skills and world renowned dishes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E4 — Arethusa Farm Dairy's Award Winning Cheese
Martha road trips to Arethusa Farm in Bantam, CT, and learns how they make their award-winning Europa cheese, visits their cheese caves, and makes their delicious cheesy risotto recipe.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E8 — The Science of Woks and Frying
Martha and Chef Kenji Lopez-Alt make extra-crunchy fried chicken sandwiches, tempura shrimp with vegetables, and finally a perfectly stir-fried beef with broccoli.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E2 — The Perfect Jams to Pair With a Simple Breakfast
One of Martha's favorite things to do is to make jam with the perfectly ripened fruit and berries grown on her Bedford farm; Martha shares her favorite recipes, as well as jam and jarring techniques.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E3 — How to Properly Cook an Egg
Meet Martha in one of her favorite places on the farm - the chicken coop to talk about one of her favorite things to eat - eggs; Martha will share her top methods for making an egg-cellent breakfast.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E8 — Martha Builds a Raised Bed Vegetable Garden
Martha builds a brand new, half-acre raised bed vegetable garden on her farm! It's a step-by-step guide to designing, building, preparing the soil, and planting.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E9 — Everything's Coming Up Roses
Everything is coming up roses on Martha's Bedford farm; Martha is creating a brand-new rose garden with almost 200 roses; from color to fragrance, the inspired world of roses is a very good thing.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E10 — Azaleas, Hostas, and Wild Birds
Martha's azalea grove is bursting with the last flowers of spring; then everything you need to know about hostas; Martha takes up bird watching.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E11 — Martha's Garden Tours of Turkey Hill and Bedford
Martha visits her former home, Turkey Hill, where everything began for Martha in the 1970s; then back to her Bedford farm for a garden club tour - a peek inside Martha's gardens past and present.
